ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on TRP-02711 is refunded to the rider in full, and no compensation is paid to the driver.

Why the fee cannot stand. The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-02711, weight 1.0) never places him inside the 50 m arrival radius for this STANDARD pickup: qualifying in-geofence fixes = 0, longest in-geofence run = 0.0 s, and his closest approach to the pin at Blk 231 Serangoon Ave 3 was 156.99 m. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02711, weight 1.0) shows the trip terminated by the driver at 20:32:36 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, with a 4.4-minute wait timer running from his pressed arrival marker. Because the driver held position outside the 50 m arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pin, POL-NS-03 governs: he did not arrive at the pickup point, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the fee is refunded in full. Independently, the effective in-geofence dwell is 0.0 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force, so POL-NS-06 also requires the full refund, whether or not the rider was present.

Fault and the driver's money. The rider's device sat 9.1-14.8 m from the pin for all 47 of her fixes, and the chat log (EV-CHAT-02711, weight 1.0) shows her message at 20:28:34 naming 'the main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A' and the driver's only reply 'ok' at 20:29:04, with no movement to her position before he cancelled 3.5 minutes later. Under POL-NS-03(i) the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation. The pin-ambiguity goodwill of SGD 2.25 does not apply: it needs two or more registered pickup points and neither party specifying a sub-location, and here registered_pickup_points is 1 and the rider did specify. POL-NS-07 pays the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which it is not. driver_compensation_sgd is therefore null. The anti-farming check does not trip (2 no-show terminations against 87 completed trips in 30 days), and neither POL-NS-09(c) nor (d) is engaged (0 + 0 counterparty disputes; 0 no-show disputes in 30 days), so nothing is withheld or escalated.

Claim by claim, on the points that could change the outcome. Never arrived / zero dwell / fare of SGD 4.50 charged and unreconciled to any refund: accepted, and they carry the refund. Rider presence at the pin: accepted as fact, but POL-NS-04 does not itself exonerate her because the driver replied within 120 seconds, so limb (b) fails; the refund does not depend on that clause. False arrival marker (POL-NS-05) and the false-arrival referral that was asked for: not made out. The marker is a BUTTON press falling at the driver's closest approach, 157 m from the pin, inside the 300 m mark, and the record does not show him travelling at 15 km/h or above at that timestamp; POL-NS-05 expressly leaves a driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius to POL-NS-03, so no false-arrival event is recorded in referrals. Recording the RIDER_NO_SHOW code as a driver-education referral (POL-NS-01): rejected. That referral is keyed to the driver's stationary fixes lying inside the arrival radius, and to a reason code outside the three limb (d) codes; here the fixes lie outside the radius and RIDER_NO_SHOW is a recognised limb (d) code, so the failure is limb (b), not limb (d).

The driver's statement that he 'was at the pickup as shown on the map' is outweighed by his own telemetry, which puts him no closer than 157 m at any point in the trip.

The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02711-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries no fact and is relied on by no finding; POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable, so no separate intervals can be summed. POL-GEN-02(2): the finding rests on EV-GPS-02711 and EV-TRIP-02711, both at weight 1.0, so the cap is 1.0 and confidence is 0.90. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so the refund executes on issue; this ruling is provisional and either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
